_about: Kombra Group family design core, 2026-10-30. One source for the family bar, collection accents and the brand list used by render.mjs. Sources: /Users/mb/kombra-sites/brand/*/tokens.json (Kombra Group, PBP, NIF rule books), live kombragroup.com :root, repo CSS. Decisions open for Michelle are listed in /Users/mb/KOMBRA_BRAND_FAMILY_1030.md section 7.

fontStacks.mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

core.typeScaleRule: Major third (1.25) from a 16px body. Footer family bar: 12px mono label, 13px links. Legal pages: 16px body, 68ch measure, line-height 1.6.
core.familyMark: Text wordmark 'kombra' + 'group' in the accent colour, as used in the kombragroup.com footer since 2026-09. No new logo drawn: a logo is her decision.

messages you send us

the questions you send
